description: End-to-end task evals for building Lynx apps directly with vanilla Lynx Element PAPI APIs, Rspeedy native artifacts, and main/background runtime event communication.

evals.name: scaffold-native-lynx-artifact-layout
evals.prompt: 我要做一个不用 ReactLynx/JSX 的 Lynx 卡片，直接用 vanilla Lynx Element PAPI。请按当前 skill 给出可被 Rspeedy 构建成原生 .bundle 的最小项目结构，并说明每个文件负责什么。
evals.expected_output: A Rspeedy vanilla Lynx project layout containing `package.json`, `lynx.config.js`, `plugin.js`, `src/card/main-thread.ts`, optional `src/card/background.ts`, `src/card/style.css`, and `src/rspeedy-env.d.ts`, with responsibilities for main-thread Element PAPI tree creation, lifecycle rendering, UI updates, optional background heavier work and patch dispatch, CSS styles, type declarations, entry/plugin configuration, and native `.bundle` artifact generation.
expectations: The answer explicitly says not to use ReactLynx, JSX, virtual DOM, or browser DOM APIs for this scenario.
The layout includes `package.json` with Rspeedy build or dev scripts, plus `lynx.config.js` for the Rspeedy entry point and plugins.
The layout includes `src/card/main-thread.ts` or another `main-thread.ts` entry and says it owns page creation, lifecycle rendering, UI updates, and Element PAPI tree mutation.
The layout says `background.ts` is optional and should only be added for heavier business logic, async work, timers, native calls, or data processing, with patches sent back to main thread.
The layout includes a CSS entry, `src/rspeedy-env.d.ts`, and `plugin.js`, and says `plugin.js` splits main/background bundles and emits the native Lynx `.bundle` artifact.

evals.name: main-thread-counter-tree
evals.prompt: 给我一个 vanilla Lynx main-thread 计数器骨架：主线程创建 page/view/text，监听 engine 生命周期，点击后把任务发给 background，收到 background patch 后更新文本并 flush。只要关键代码结构，不要 React 代码。
evals.expected_output: A main-thread entry that uses `lynx.getEngine()` for `__RenderPage`, `__UpdatePage`, and `__DestroyLifetime`, uses Element PAPI APIs on the main thread to create and mutate the tree, uses `lynx.getJSContext()` to communicate with the background thread, flushes only after later updates, and removes runtime listeners during destroy.
expectations: The code uses `lynx.getEngine()` and the engine-defined lifecycle event names `__RenderPage`, `__UpdatePage`, and `__DestroyLifetime` exactly.
The code creates the UI tree on the main thread with Element PAPI APIs such as `__CreatePage`, `__GetElementUniqueID`, `__CreateView`, `__CreateText` or `__CreateRawText`, and `__AppendElement`.
The code uses `lynx.getJSContext()` to access the background-thread environment and dispatch a UI task or data event to it.
The code receives a background patch, mutates existing text or child nodes on the main thread, and calls `__FlushElementTree()` after that later mutation.
The code does not call `__FlushElementTree()` during initial `renderPage`, and it removes engine or background listeners when `__DestroyLifetime` runs.

evals.name: double-thread-data-sync
evals.prompt: vanilla Lynx 双线程数据同步里 main-thread.ts 和 background.ts 怎么分工？请按当前事件 API 说明 first-screen data、点击任务、异步/重计算、patch 回主线程、销毁清理。
evals.expected_output: An explanation that main thread owns Element PAPI tree creation, mutation, lifecycle rendering, and UI flushes; main thread uses `lynx.getJSContext()` to forward processed data, UI tasks, and destroy lifecycle to background; background uses `lynx.getCoreContext()` to listen for main-thread messages, run heavier work, keep background-owned state, and dispatch serializable patches back; main thread applies patches and cleanup removes listeners.
expectations: The response says `main-thread.ts` owns Element PAPI tree creation, node mutation, UI flushes, and engine lifecycle handling for `__RenderPage`, `__UpdatePage`, and `__DestroyLifetime` through `lynx.getEngine()`.
The response says `main-thread.ts` uses `lynx.getJSContext()` to dispatch processed first-screen or update data, UI tasks, and destroy lifecycle to the background-thread environment.
The response says `background.ts` uses `lynx.getCoreContext()` to listen for main-thread messages and dispatch `UpdateDataFromBackground` or equivalent serializable patches back.
The response says heavier async, timer, native, data-processing, or business logic belongs in `background.ts`, and background code must not call Element PAPI APIs or `__FlushElementTree()`.
The response says main thread applies background patches to Element PAPI nodes, calls `__FlushElementTree()` after later UI mutations, and runtime listeners are removed during destroy.
